svg.title: Portrait with a fruit headdress — detailed vector rendering
svg.desc: Detailed stylised vector rendition of 01test_image-vision-model.jpeg: a woman in a violet wrapped turban crowned with apples, grapes, a pear, a lime and a lemon, in three-quarter view, with gold filigree earrings, a beaded necklace, an embroidered ivory top and a raised hand with scarlet nails, against a bright studio background.
